documents.title: Gold fare baggage
documents.text: Gold fare includes one 23 kg checked bag only. A second checked bag costs 60 EUR.

documents.title: Silver fare baggage
documents.text: Silver fare includes one 23 kg checked bag. A second checked bag costs 60 EUR.

documents.title: Basic fare baggage
documents.text: Basic fare includes one cabin bag up to 7 kg. Checked baggage is not included; a 23 kg checked bag costs 45 EUR.

documents.title: Basic fare cancellation
documents.text: Basic tickets are non-refundable. Date changes cost 75 EUR plus fare difference.

documents.title: Gold fare cancellation
documents.text: Gold tickets can be cancelled free of charge up to 24 hours before departure.

documents.title: Gold seat selection
documents.text: Gold members select standard seats free of charge; extra-legroom seats cost 25 EUR.

documents.title: Cabin pets
documents.text: Silver fare: you can bring one cat or small dog in the cabin for 50 EUR on selected routes. The pet carrier counts as your cabin bag and must fit under the seat in front.

documents.title: Schengen visa
documents.text: Schengen visas are required for non-EU passport holders; apply at least 15 days before departure.

documents.title: Gold fare baggage (2024 edition)
documents.text: Gold fare checked bag allowance: two 23 kg checked bags are included at no extra charge.

documents.title: Silver fare cancellation
documents.text: Silver tickets can be cancelled for 50 EUR up to 48 hours before departure.

documents.title: Basic fare seats
documents.text: Basic fare seats are assigned at check-in; choosing a seat earlier costs 12 EUR.

documents.title: Silver fare seats
documents.text: Silver members choose standard seats free of charge from 7 days before departure.

documents.title: Gold fare meals
documents.text: Gold fare includes a hot meal and drinks on flights longer than two hours.

documents.title: Gold lounge access
documents.text: Gold members may use partner lounges with one guest.

documents.title: Silver fare date changes
documents.text: Silver tickets allow one free date change; further changes cost 40 EUR plus fare difference.

documents.title: Sports equipment
documents.text: Skis, golf clubs and bicycles travel as a checked item for 55 EUR on every fare.

documents.title: Travelling with infants
documents.text: Infants under two travel on a parent's lap for 25 EUR, including one free stroller at the gate.

documents.title: Delays and missed flights
documents.text: Delays over three hours give a meal voucher; after five hours you may cancel for a full refund.

documents.title: Special assistance
documents.text: Wheelchair assistance is free on every fare; request it 48 hours before departure.

documents.title: Delayed or damaged luggage
documents.text: Report delayed or damaged luggage within 7 days at the airport desk or online.
